prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [反例] 组标题长于子列 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Merged cells: "城市" spans 1 col × 2 row; "空气质量指数（AQI）月度平均值" spans 3 col × 1 row; "说明" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "城市" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "空气质量指数（AQI）月度平均值 › 一月" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 3: header "空气质量指数（AQI）月度平均值 › 二月" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 4: header "空气质量指数（AQI）月度平均值 › 三月" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 353px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示北京、上海和广州前三个月的空气质量指数月均值，并补充各城市的情况说明。","reading":"读者按行查看同一城市的三个月数据和说明，也会沿各月列比较城市；城市名与数值应易于快速对应。","groups":["一月、二月和三月属于同一指标的并列子列，承担相同作用，宜保持等宽。","说明列对应整行数据，文字较长，可利用换行与数值行保持关联。"],"keep_intact":["城市名称和月份名称","各月 AQI 数值","标题中的 AQI 字母组合"],"may_wrap":["空气质量指数的组标题可在中文词语之间换行。","说明列可自然换行；较长说明形成的行高也能容纳同一行其他单元格的内容。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [52, 52, 52, 52, 151] · table 360×299px · row heights [60, 36, 83, 36, 83] · column headers wrapped 1/6 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [52, 54, 54, 54, 145] · table 360×299px · row heights [60, 36, 83, 36, 83] · column headers wrapped 1/6 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"城市名、月份名和数值完整；三个月等宽，便于横向和纵向比较。说明列较宽，长说明均为三行，行与城市数据的对应关系清楚。","problems":"组标题折成两行，上层表头较高；说明列仍然密集，广州说明中的短句末尾单独占据一行。","cause":"三个52px的月份列合计156px，组标题无法排成一行；说明列151px，扣除边框和内边距后可用宽度有限。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"月份列等宽且略宽，数值排列清楚；组标题和说明均未出现词中断裂，整体高度与r1A相同。","problems":"额外分给月份列的宽度没有减少表头行数，却压缩了说明列；长说明仍占三行，视觉上比r1A更拥挤。","cause":"月份列各增至54px，说明列降至145px；三列合计162px仍不足以容纳单行组标题。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"说明优先","widths":[52,50,50,50,157],"change":"月份列各缩至50px，仍保留完整月份名和数值，将节省的宽度交给说明列，观察长说明的换行是否更舒展。"},{"name":"更宽说明","widths":[52,48,48,48,163],"change":"进一步缩小等宽月份列，为说明争取更多空间；检验较窄的月份列是否仍有足够呼吸感，以及说明能否形成更均衡的行长。"},{"name":"均衡留白","widths":[52,51,51,51,154],"change":"在r1A基础上轻微收窄月份列，为说明增加宽度，保留接近原设计的列间节奏。"}]}
